title: Lumicode
description: A small mod api hosting some features used in my mods
body:
Lumicode is a simple library mod to help with the creation of some mods.

## Features
### Pride Beacons
Using amethyst, the player is able to make any beacon's beam into a pride variant using the different growth of amethyst crystals as different strenths / saturations.

![An image overview of the pride beacons in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/557d251da95637e976df6af3136a8be2c48fa471.png)

### Reworked entity path finder
Using a custom path finder, a developer is able to import this new path finding code for their own entities. This is **NOT** bound to every mob by default and the developer has to bind it themselves. (Deafult Minecraft pathfinding on the left, revised / improved on the right)

![A gif displaying the default entity pathfinding on the left, and the revised / improved on the right](https://yt3.ggpht.com/GdmYItnKxdDN98tJBlToam1EKc8uQWcGgnS-rq4SC6c3Ji9SZy4NWEMC85nUk5VPjk3qjaDr4xmKUP0=s576-nd-v1-rwa)
